overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（3 篇）、房地产金融（1 篇）。方法上以实验方法、随机过程为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、OpenAlex（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Secant deep hyperbolic cosine bio inspired whale optimization for building detection from satellite images
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Building detection from satellite images is a demanding task and also considered as a hot research topic over the past few years. Deep Learning-based models are applied for object detection. One of the biggest challenges in the Deep Learning-based models learning is the selection of parameter and optimization process. Also numerous models have been proposed using bio-inspired optimization solutions to solve this problem. In this work, to avoid local optima and ensuring a smooth balance of exploration and exploitation involved in building detection, a method called, Secant Deep Belief Network-based Hyperbolic Cosine Whale Optimization (SDBN-HCWO) is proposed. The bio-inspired Hyperbolic Cosine Whale Optimization processes works under the Secant Deep Belief Network. The Secant Deep Belief Network consists of visible and hidden layer. Three hidden layers are employed to detect best edges. In the first hidden layer, Hyperbolic Cosine Prey Encircling is employed to find best edges. The detected edges are linked in second hidden layer with the aid of Shrinking Encircle and Spiral Update-based optimal edge linking model. Lastly, Secant Object Detection model is applied in third hidden layer to perform the robust building detection in an accurate way. The performance of the SDBN-HCWO method is evaluated quantitatively and qualitatively based on the best fitness values. The experimental outcomes of proposed SDBN-HCWO method yields better performance results in terms of higher peak signal-to-noise ratio by 18%, classification accuracy by 20% and reduced classification time by 26% and false positive rate by 68% than the other state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
从卫星图像中检测建筑物是一项具有挑战性的任务，同时也是近年来备受关注的热门研究课题。基于深度学习的模型被广泛应用于目标检测领域。在深度学习模型的研究中，最大的挑战之一在于参数的选择与优化过程。为了解决这一问题，人们提出了许多采用生物启发式优化算法的模型。本文提出了一种名为“基于割线深度信念网络的双曲余弦鲸鱼优化算法（SDBN-HCWO）”的方法，旨在避免局部最优解，并实现探索与利用之间的平衡。该算法基于割线深度信念网络（Secant Deep Belief Network）进行优化，该网络包含可见层和隐藏层，其中使用了三个隐藏层来精确检测建筑物的边缘。在第一隐藏层中，采用双曲余弦捕食者包围（Hyperbolic Cosine Prey Encircling）算法来寻找最佳边缘；在第二隐藏层中，通过收缩包围（Shrinking Encircle）和螺旋更新（Spiral Update）算法实现边缘的连接；最后在第三隐藏层应用割线目标检测（Secant Object Detection）模型，以准确地进行建筑物检测。通过定量和定性的评估方法，证明了SDBN-HCWO算法的优...。研究方法：深度学习、实验方法、优化方法。

papers.title: Urban Elites and the Making of the Eventful City: Non-State Governance and Spatial Coalitions in Olympic Milan
papers.venue: International Journal of the Sociology of Leisure
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  This paper examines the role of private real estate and financial actors in Milan’s urban transformation through the case of the redevelopment of the former Porta Romana railway yard, site of the Olympic Village for the Milan-Cortina 2026 Winter Games. Focusing on three key actors — Coima, Covivio, and Prada Holding, gathered within the Porta Romana Fund — the paper investigates their relationships with local public institutions in a context of hybrid urban governance. Drawing on a mixed-methods approach that combines mapping of real estate and non-real estate activities, interlocking directorate analysis, and semi-structured interviews, the study reconstructs the multidimensional urban presence of these actors. They emerge not only as property market operators, but also as influential participants in Milan’s cultural, environmental, and symbolic production. Between 2014 and 2025, they promoted numerous real estate projects in strategic urban areas while simultaneously engaging in cultural and social initiatives. Network analysis reveals a small-world structure, suggesting the existence of a cohesive urban business elite well positioned to facilitate information flows and strategic coordination. Local government appears primarily as an institutional enabler, helping to create regulatory and symbolic conditions favourable to private capital, rather than as a redistributive steering actor. Mega-events thus operate less as exceptional ruptures than as policy windows that accelerate existing valorisation trajectories and legitimise a market-led model of urban development. The Milanese case points to the consolidation of a loosely structured but sufficiently coherent urban coalition capable of exerting sustained influence over the city’s development trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
【房地产金融】摘要  
本文通过分析米兰前Porta Romana铁路场地的重新开发案例，探讨了私营房地产企业和金融参与者在米兰城市转型中的作用。该场地曾用于2026年米兰-科尔蒂纳冬季奥运会的奥运村建设。研究重点关注三个关键参与者——Coima、Covivio和Prada Holding（它们共同组成了Porta Romana基金），并分析了它们在混合式城市治理框架下与当地公共机构的关系。研究采用混合方法，结合了房地产与非房地产活动的调查、董事会成员交叉任职关系的分析以及半结构化访谈，全面揭示了这些参与者的多维城市影响力。它们不仅作为房地产市场运营商发挥作用，还积极参与米兰的文化、环境及象征性建设。2014年至2025年间，这些企业在关键城市区域推动了多项房地产项目，并同时开展了一系列文化和社会公益活动。网络分析显示，这些企业形成了一个小世界结构，表明存在一个紧密联系的城市商业精英群体，能够有效促进信息交流和战略协调。地方政府主要扮演制度支持者的角色，为私营资本创造有利的监管和象征性环境，而非直接参与资源再分配。因此，大型体育赛事更像是加速现有城市发展路径的政策契机，而非导致城市发展模式根本...。

papers.title: Multidimensional Risk Made Easy
papers.abstract: Suppose we want to assign a certainty equivalent--one number--to a multivariate risk. Which such assignments are law-invariant, monotone with respect to vector stochastic dominance, and invariant to independent background risk? I show that every such certainty equivalent is a positive mixture of scalar entropic certainty equivalents applied to positive projections of the vector risk. The same representation yields a robust-order characterization: unanimity across such certainty equivalents is equivalent, up to closure, to dominance after adding independent multidimensional background risk. In a social-welfare specialization, the corresponding shadow valuations are welfare weights.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】假设我们希望为一种多元风险赋予一个“确定性等价值”——即一个具体的数值。那么，哪些这样的赋值既符合法律不变性（law-invariance），又具备向量随机优势（vector stochastic dominance）的单调性，并且对独立的背景风险（independent background risk）保持不变呢？我证明了，每一个这样的确定性等价值都可以表示为对向量风险的正投影进行标量熵确定性等价值（scalar entropic certainty equivalents）的正向组合。这种表示方法还揭示了一个稳健的排序特性：在这些确定性等价值之间达成一致（即“一致性”），在经过闭包运算（closure）后，等同于在加入独立的多维背景风险后仍然能够保持优势关系（dominance）。在社会福利分析的框架下，相应的“影子估值”（shadow valuations）就构成了福利权重（welfare weights）。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: When large trades are not news: Liquidity tail risk and price discovery
papers.abstract: When is a large trade news, and when is it a liquidity shock? We study this question in a sequential competitive limit order book with asymmetric information. In our model, liquidity suppliers observe aggregate order flow but not its decomposition into informed demand and uninformed liquidity demand. We model uninformed order flow with Student-$t$ tails, interpreted as a reduced form for rare liquidity regimes. The tail index of liquidity demand determines how informative large trades are. With thin-tailed noise, large order imbalances are quickly interpreted as private information. With heavy-tailed liquidity demand, the same imbalances remain plausibly liquidity-driven. This liquidity-tail ambiguity flattens and concavifies price impact, slows learning from order flow, and delays the decline of adverse-selection premia. We characterize equilibrium through a fixed-point equation for the marginal-cost schedule. Heavy-tailed liquidity demand changes the mathematics of equilibrium: the Gaussian monotonicity and compactness arguments fail because remote liquidity states remain pricing-relevant at polynomial order. We construct fixed points on a tail-controlled compact class and study learning and large-order asymptotics along selected monotone branches. Repeated order flow reveals the fundamental value under stable information-rate conditions, but heavier liquidity tails slow finite-horizon price discovery. Large-order impact obeys regular-variation asymptotics whose exponents depend on the liquidity-tail index, informed competition, and posterior beliefs. The model identifies liquidity tail risk as a state variable for market impact, spread resilience, and the informativeness of large trades.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】何时是一则重要的交易新闻，何时又是一次流动性冲击？我们在一个存在信息不对称的顺序竞争式限价订单簿模型中探讨了这一问题。在我们的模型中，流动性供应者能够观察到总订单流量，但无法区分其中来自知情需求和不知情流动性需求的部分。我们使用学生t分布（Student-t distribution）来模拟不知情订单流量，将其视为罕见流动性状况的简化模型。流动性需求的尾部指数决定了大宗交易的信息含量。在噪声分布较薄的情况下，大额订单失衡很快会被解读为私人信息；而在流动性需求分布较重（即尾部较厚）的情况下，同样的订单失衡仍可能主要源于流动性因素。这种流动性尾部特征的不确定性会使得价格变动的幅度变得平缓或凹陷，减缓从订单流量中获取信息的过程，并延缓负面选择溢价（adverse-selection premia）的下降。我们通过边际成本函数的不动点方程来描述市场均衡状态。流动性需求的重尾特性改变了均衡的数学性质：原本基于高斯分布的单调性和紧凑性假设不再成立，因为远端的流动性状态在多项式阶数上仍然对价格形成有重要影响。我们在一个受尾部特征控制的紧凑集合上构建了均衡解，并沿着选定的单调路径研究了学习过程及...。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Trust in Annual Reports: The Role of Corporate Online Interactions With Investors
papers.abstract: This paper examines whether and how corporate online interactions with investors shape trust in annual reports. We focus on annual report comment letters, through which regulators publicly question the credibility of firms' disclosures, providing a suitable setting to observe investor trust. We find that sustained high‐quality interactions significantly mitigate the negative market reaction to comment letters, suggesting that such interactions strengthen investor trust. These results are robust to instrumental variable estimation, the Heckman two‐stage model and additional sensitivity analyses. Mechanism analyses indicate that high‐quality interactions enhance trust primarily by conveying credible signals of lower agency costs. Consistent with a signalling mechanism, high‐quality responses to negative inquiries have stronger effects on investor trust, while short‐term interactions play a limited role. The trust effect is concentrated among firms whose investors rely more on such signals. Further analysis shows that investor trust rapidly collapses when subsequent response letters reveal underlying problems and is reinforced when such problems are absent. Finally, high‐quality interactions are associated with more favourable regulatory recognition. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of high‐quality online communication in strengthening investor trust and offer implications for capital market participants.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文探讨了企业与投资者之间的在线互动是否以及如何影响投资者对年度报告的信任。我们重点关注年度报告中的评论信件，这些信件是监管机构公开质疑企业信息披露可信度的方式，为观察投资者信任提供了合适的视角。研究发现，持续的高质量互动能够显著减轻市场对评论信件的负面反应，表明此类互动有助于增强投资者信任。这些结果在工具变量估计、Heckman两阶段模型以及额外的敏感性分析中均具有稳定性。机制分析表明，高质量互动主要通过传递企业代理成本较低的可信信号来提升信任。与信号传递机制一致，对企业负面质疑的高质量回应对投资者信任的提振作用更为显著，而短期互动的作用则较为有限。这种信任效应主要体现在那些投资者更依赖此类信号的企业中。进一步分析显示，当后续的回复信件揭示出企业存在的问题时，投资者信任会迅速下降；而当这些问题不存在时，信任又会得到恢复。最后，高质量互动还与企业获得更积极的监管认可相关。总体而言，这些发现强调了高质量在线沟通在增强投资者信任方面的重要性，并为资本市场参与者提供了启示。。研究方法：工具变量。

papers.title: Exploring the Nonlinear Relationship between Fiscal Policy and Economic Growth in Uganda: A NARDL Perspective
papers.abstract: This study examines the asymmetric effects of fiscal policy on economic growth in Uganda using annual data from 1983 to 2020 obtained from the Uganda Revenue Authority and the World Bank. Employing the Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) and Phillips-Perron (PP) tests, the results reveal a mixture of I(0) and I(1) variables, justifying the use of the NARDL bounds testing approach to cointegration. The findings confirm a long-run cointegrating relationship among the variables and demonstrate significant asymmetric effects of fiscal policy, particularly government expenditure and tax revenue on economic growth in the long run, while short-run asymmetry is mainly observed in tax revenue, with overall fiscal responses appearing symmetric. These results imply that positive and negative fiscal shocks have differing impacts on growth over time, leading to the recommendation that fiscal policy be strategically directed toward productive investments, improved private sector support, and the creation of an enabling environment to accelerate sustainable economic growth and facilitate the attainment of middle-income status.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究利用乌干达税务局和世界银行提供的1983年至2020年的年度数据，探讨了财政政策对乌干达经济增长的不对称影响。通过采用增广迪基-富勒（ADF）检验和菲利普斯-佩龙（PP）检验，研究发现这些变量既具有I(0)特征，也具有I(1)特征，因此有必要运用NARDL边界检验方法来分析它们的协整关系。研究结果证实了这些变量之间存在长期协整关系，并表明财政政策（尤其是政府支出和税收收入）对经济增长具有显著的不对称效应；在短期内，税收收入的不对称性更为明显，而总体而言财政政策的反应呈现出对称性。这些结果表明，积极的和消极的财政冲击对经济增长的影响随时间而异，因此建议财政政策应战略性地投向生产性投资、加强对私营部门的扶持，并营造有利于可持续经济增长的环境，以帮助乌干达实现中等收入国家的目标。。研究方法：协整分析。

papers.title: Nina Bang om kvinders adgang til tjenestestillinger og erhverv
papers.abstract: i ordførertalen i 1919 i landstinget satte Nina Bang som den eneste fokus på klasseproblematikken i lovforslaget. at lukke borgerskabets kvinder ud af hjemmene og ind på arbejdsmarkedet synes hun var en god ide. men hun påpegede samtidig at der var stor forskel på de vilkår som henholdsvis arbejderklassens og borgerskabets udearbejdende kvinder var underlagt.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】1919年，尼娜·邦（Nina Bang）在挪威议会（Landstinget）的发言中是唯一一个将阶级问题作为法案核心议题的人。她认为，让资产阶级女性走出家庭、进入劳动力市场是个好主意。但她同时指出，工人阶级女性和资产阶级女性在就业条件方面存在巨大差异。。

papers.title: The Economic Benefits and Costs of AI and Policies to Mitigate AI's Impact on Inequality
papers.abstract: We examine the economic impact of increasingly productive AI and policies that spread its benefits across the economy. Improvements in AI productivity trigger labor reallocation and changes in absolute and relative wages for different types of labor. Wages of labor that is essential for building AI increase faster than overall GDP. Wages of labor that is substituted for by AI decrease in both absolute and relative terms. Wages of labor that is used only in final goods production and is not displaced by AI increase in line with overall GDP. We contrast the impact of productivity gains depending on whether AI production is competitive or monopolistic. Monopoly production of AI restricts its deployment, slowing the transition and impact of AI. Optimal tax and regulatory policies that achieve Pareto-improvements differ depending on whether there is competition in AI production.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】我们研究了生产力不断提高的人工智能（AI）及其相关政策对经济的影响，这些政策旨在将AI带来的好处惠及整个经济体系。AI生产力的提升会引发劳动力重新配置，并导致不同类型劳动力的绝对工资和相对工资发生变化：对于那些对AI发展至关重要的劳动力而言，其工资增长速度超过了整体GDP的增长速度；而被AI取代的劳动力，其工资无论是在绝对值还是相对值上都会下降；而仅参与最终产品生产且未被AI取代的劳动力，其工资则会随着整体GDP的增长而上升。我们进一步分析了生产力提升所带来的影响，具体取决于AI生产是处于竞争性还是垄断性环境。在垄断性生产环境下，AI的应用受到限制，从而减缓了AI技术的普及及其对经济的实际影响。为实现帕累托改进（即提高资源配置效率），最优的税收和监管政策也会因AI生产是否存在竞争而有所不同。。

papers.title: Competitive effects of transmission constraints in the German electricity market
papers.abstract: This paper estimates the effect of cross-border transmission constraints on suspected market power abuse in the German wholesale electricity market. Using a 2SRI instrumental variables approach, we study suspected strategic behavior by German gas- and coal-fired power plants in 2022-2024. Cross-border transmission constraints are measured using the maximum and minimum bounds of zonal net position, while suspected market power abuse is measured as the upward or downward deviation of observed dispatch from a modeled competitive benchmark. We find that transmission constraints significantly elevate the likelihood of suspected market power abuse. When headroom for further imports is already scarce, reducing import headroom by one Gigawatt (GW) increases the odds of suspected capacity withholding by 15%. Similarly, reducing export headroom by one GW when it is scarce increases the odds of suspected capacity push-in, a strategy to depress prices, by 16%. These results provide empirical support for interconnection expansion as an instrument to mitigate market power.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文估计了跨境输电限制对德国批发电力市场疑似市场力量滥用行为的影响。采用2SRI工具变量方法，我们研究了2022至2024年间德国燃气发电厂和燃煤发电厂的疑似战略性行为。跨境输电限制通过区域净功率的最大值和最小值来衡量，而疑似市场力量滥用则通过实际调度量与模拟竞争基准之间的偏差（无论是向上还是向下）来判定。研究发现，输电限制显著增加了疑似市场力量滥用行为的发生概率。当进一步进口的余地已经很有限时，每减少1吉瓦（GW）的进口容量，疑似限制发电量的可能性会增加15%；同样地，当出口容量余地有限时，每减少1吉瓦的出口容量，采用压低价格策略（即“推高发电量”）的可能性会增加16%。这些结果为通过扩大电力互联互通来缓解市场力量滥用提供了实证支持。。研究方法：工具变量。

papers.title: Tail Risk Management with Puts and Trend Following: A CVaR Framework for Crashes and Drawdowns
papers.abstract: Tail-risk management is not only an instrument-selection problem. It is an allocation problem across loss mechanisms: abrupt crash states, volatility repricing, and persistent drawdowns require different forms of protection. This paper develops a continuous-time CVaR framework that places two common protection sleeves -- long out-of-the-money put options and systematic trend-following overlays -- inside one coherent tail-risk mandate. The option sleeve is modeled as a marked-to-market traded asset, so premium drag, diffusion exposure, and jump repricing enter through its physical return process rather than through inconsistent terminal-payoff accounting. The resulting Markov state contains wealth, spot, stochastic variance, and an exponentially weighted log-return signal, and we derive the associated Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation in viscosity form. The main analytical separation is temporal: convex insurance reprices immediately on jump impact, whereas trend following is late on the first shock because its signal must cross zero, but becomes increasingly defensive during persistent drawdowns without requiring fresh option premium. We then give sufficient and local conditions for an interior hybrid allocation, derive a CVaR policy-gradient identity, and introduce a four-axis diagnostic layer separating conditional convexity, tail-event reliability, non-stress carry, and drawdown persistence. Stylized Monte Carlo experiments illustrate the mechanism: fixed equal-weight hybrids and grid-optimized hybrids reduce terminal CVaR relative to either pure sleeve in the reported regimes, while the exact weight location remains calibration-dependent. The contribution is a transparent risk-management framework for deciding how much convex crash protection and how much signal-driven drawdown protection a mandate should hold.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】尾部风险管理不仅仅是一个工具选择问题，它还涉及到在不同损失机制之间的资产配置问题：突发性市场崩溃、波动性重新定价以及持续性资金回撤都需要采取不同的保护措施。本文构建了一个连续时间下的条件风险价值（CVaR）框架，将两种常见的保护手段——长期虚值看跌期权和系统性趋势跟踪策略——纳入到一个统一的尾部风险管理框架中。该框架将期权部分视为一种按市场价值计价的交易资产，因此期权溢价的影响、市场波动风险以及价格跳跃带来的重新定价效应都是通过资产的实际收益过程来体现的，而非通过复杂的终端支付计算方式来处理。由此产生的马尔可夫状态包含了资产价值、现货价格、随机方差以及一个指数加权对数收益信号，我们据此推导出了相应的哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼方程（Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation）。主要的分析区别在于时间效应：凸性保险策略会在价格跳跃发生时立即进行调整；而趋势跟踪策略则会在首次市场冲击后延迟响应（因为其信号需要先穿过零点），但在资产持续回撤期间会逐渐采取更为保守的策略，且无需额外支付期权费用。我们进一步提出了内部混合资产配置的充分条件与局部约束，推导出了CVaR策略梯度...。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、模型校准、实验方法、随机过程。

papers.title: A characterization of the von Neumann and Morgenstern stable set in matching markets
papers.abstract: This paper studies the structure and computation of von Neumann-Morgenstern (vNM) stable sets in one-to-one matching markets. While pairwise stability and corewise stability coincide under strict preferences and provide a well-understood benchmark, vNM stability is defined through dominance relations among sets of matchings and remains considerably more difficult to characterize. A key contribution of the paper is a generalization of the classical Decomposition Lemma. We show that the structural decomposition traditionally used to compare stable matchings extends to any pair of matchings belonging to the same internally stable set. This result reveals a previously unexplored connection between internal stability and the cycle structure underlying matching markets. Building on this characterization, we identify the relationships that are relevant for dominance-based stability and derive a reduced environment that concentrates all undominated outcomes. Our main result shows that the vNM stable set is unique and admits a simple characterization in terms of the core of this reduced environment. The characterization provides both structural insight and a constructive procedure for computing the vNM stable set using standard matching theoretic tools.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文研究了一对一匹配市场中冯·诺伊曼-摩根斯坦（von Neumann-Morgenstern, vNM）稳定集的结构与计算方法。在严格偏好条件下，成对稳定性和核心稳定性是一致的，并构成了一个易于理解的评估标准；然而，vNM稳定性则是通过匹配集合之间的支配关系来定义的，其特性要复杂得多。本文的一个关键贡献是对经典“分解引理”（Decomposition Lemma）进行了推广。我们证明了传统上用于比较稳定匹配的结构分解方法可以应用于属于同一内部稳定集的任意两对匹配。这一发现揭示了内部稳定性与匹配市场潜在循环结构之间之前未被探索的联系。基于这一特性分析，我们确定了与基于支配关系的稳定性相关的因素，并构建了一个简化后的环境，该环境能够集中所有未被支配的匹配结果。我们的主要结果表明，vNM稳定集是唯一的，并且可以通过该简化环境的核心来简洁地对其进行描述。这种描述方法不仅提供了对稳定集结构的深入理解，还为使用标准匹配理论工具计算vNM稳定集提供了可行的方法。。

papers.title: Shapley in Context: Explaining Financial Language with Domain Expertise
papers.abstract: In recent years, large language models have achieved remarkable success and have seen growing adoption in financial applications. At the same time, explainability remains critical in finance, a domain characterized by high stakes and strict regulatory requirements. Although numerous methods have been proposed to explain black box machine learning models, the majority of these approaches are designed for general purpose tasks and do not incorporate domain specific knowledge. In this work, we study the explainability of financial textual data modeled by large language models through the lens of the Shapley value. Specifically, we investigate whether Shapley based attributions align with established financial domain knowledge. Through rigorous theoretical analysis and extensive empirical evaluations, we demonstrate that Shapley values can yield explanations that are consistent with financial reasoning and can offer meaningful insights into the model's behavior in text based financial applications.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】近年来，大型语言模型取得了显著的成功，并在金融应用中得到了越来越多的采用。与此同时，在金融领域，可解释性仍然至关重要——该领域具有高风险和严格的监管要求。尽管已经提出了许多方法来解释黑盒机器学习模型，但大多数这些方法都是为通用任务设计的，并没有结合特定领域的知识。在这项工作中，我们通过Shapley值的视角研究了大型语言模型对金融文本数据的解释能力。具体而言，我们探讨了基于Shapley值的解释结果是否与已建立的金融领域知识相一致。通过严谨的理论分析和广泛的实证评估，我们证明了Shapley值能够提供与金融逻辑相符的解释，并能够为模型在基于文本的金融应用中的行为提供有意义的见解。。研究方法：机器学习、大语言模型。
